Welcome, epic being.

You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call Beyond the Veil.

On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, a gate will open in the hills of Austin to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.

This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that does the opposite. Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.

This event is your canvas, and your gifts are the paint. Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!

Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your essence.

As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, let your “try” die, and let your gifts live.

Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, how to buy tickets, ride-sharing options and parking. Read on and secure your place. This event will 100% sell out!

See you on the other side…Michael & Austin Dance Temple

Important details

The Group Agreement

This is a curated guest list. Everyone here was invited because we trust them to care for the room and the people in it.

Consent matters here, from personal space to photos. By attending, you agree to:

  1. Ask first.Ask before you hug, touch, or photograph someone.
  2. Respect the answer.A no, or a change of mind, is honored right away, with no questions asked.
  3. When in doubt, don't.If you're not sure, the answer is no.

We'll open the night by naming these agreements together at the opening ceremony. Anyone who doesn't honor them will be asked to leave.

Your costume

Outfit / Dress

This night is asking you to GO BIG, so treat your costume creation as part of the experience, not an afterthought.

  • Plan ahead. Start now, use the moodboard and Etsy idea links below, and order anything you need early so you're not scrambling at the last moment for a long-shot Etsy delivery.
  • Go big, be bold. Step out of your comfort zone, and show up as the version of you that finally got the permission slip to be unapologetically yourself.
  • Dress for the whole night. You'll be moving through different energies and spaces and even spending time outdoors at times, so wear layers you can shed as it unfolds. We'll have plenty of places for coats, bags and your extra items to be stored.

Fair warning

A last-minute costume-in-a-bag from Amazon IS NOT what we're doing here. If you show up in a zero-effort onesie, expect to be playfully roasted and sent to the costume corner to change before you cross the veil.

You got this... we believe in you! ;)

Getting there

The Venue

Beyond the Veil is hosted at HAVAN, a private estate in west Austin/Lakeway chosen for its beauty, intimacy and spaciousness.

HAVAN 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738 Open in Maps

Event Start

Please arrive during the arrival window (7 to 8 PM) to preserve the integrity and flow of the experience.

Doors open
7 PM
Doors close
8 PM

Parking

Parking at HAVAN is very limited, so we're offering a small number of parking passes for $50 per car. Add one to your order at checkout.

Only cars with a parking pass will be allowed on the property, so if you don't have one, please rideshare or arrange a drop-off.

Ridesharing

We strongly encourage rideshare, carpools, and drop-offs. HAVAN sits in a remote part of the hills outside Austin, and finding a ride home late at night or early in the morning can be difficult, so please arrange your ride home before you arrive.

To make it easier, we've created a WhatsApp group just for Beyond the Veil guests. Join it to coordinate carpools to and from HAVAN.

Join the rideshare WhatsApp group

Read everything below

Inside the Gates

  • Phones, Pictures, Videos

    Professional photography will be provided at the beginning of the night, but after the opening ceremonies, all phones should be stored away and out of sight. You can use your phones for dedicated pictures and video time (7 to 9 PM), and then we ask you to put them away so we can enjoy the night.

    Ask for consent from anyone you are taking a picture or video of BEFORE doing so.

  • Respect the space

    Please treat the property, the art, and the furnishings with care.

  • Shoes

    Shoes will be allowed for this event if they are a part of your costume. Otherwise, take your shoes off and leave them at the front door outside.

  • Pets

    No animal pets will be allowed at the party or on the property.

Food and Drink

  • Come fed. We'll have a grazing table and plenty of water and non-alcoholic drinks, but this is not a dinner, so please eat a nourishing meal before you arrive.
  • Alcohol-free. This is an alcohol-free event, so please leave outside alcohol at home.

About Plus-Ones

Beyond the Veil is a curated gathering, and our guest list has been carefully assembled. Your invitation is personal and doesn't include a plus-one.

Know someone who would add real magic to this night? You can nominate them below. Our team reviews every nomination, and with so few places left, we can't promise a ticket. If there's a fit, we'll reach out to them directly.

Quick answers

Questions

Who is this for?

Our curated community, 21 and over. Bring your ID.

Can I bring a plus-one?

No, every invitation is personal. Nominate them instead, and our team will review it.

When should I arrive?

Between 7 and 8 PM; doors close at 8. The opening ceremony starts at 8:30.

Can I leave and come back?

No, there's no re-entry once you're inside.

When does it end?

Music runs until sunrise, around 6:45 AM. Leave whenever you like, but book your ride home before you arrive.

Is there alcohol?

No, this is an alcohol-free event. Please leave outside alcohol at home.

Will there be food?

A grazing table, water and non-alcoholic drinks, plus tea service by Casa Akasha. It's not a dinner, so eat a nourishing meal first.

Where is it?

HAVAN, 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738. It's a private estate in the hills of west Austin and Lakeway.

How do I get there?

Rideshare, carpool or get dropped off. Join the guest WhatsApp group to share rides.

Can I park on site?

Only with a $50 parking pass, added at checkout. Cars without one won't be allowed on the property.

Can I use my phone?

Yes, from 7 to 9 PM for photos and video, always with consent. After that, phones go away for the night.

Will there be a photographer?

Yes, professional photography is provided at the beginning of the night.

What should I wear?

Go big in iridescent, metallic, pearl, chrome, silver, gold or smoke. Zero-effort costumes get sent to the costume corner.

Where do my coat and bag go?

We'll have plenty of places to store coats, bags and extra layers.

Do I keep my shoes on?

Only if they're part of your costume. Otherwise, leave them at the front door outside.

Can I bring my pet?

No animal pets are allowed at the party or on the property.

Can I get a refund or transfer my ticket?

Yes, both are allowed. Email us and we'll take care of it.

What if it sells out?

A waitlist opens. You can also nominate as many people as you like.

What's LoveStack?

A supplement protocol by VESSEL, our official supplement partner. Add it to your ticket for 20% off and pick it up when you arrive.

What if someone crosses a line?

Anyone who doesn't honor the group agreements will be asked to leave. Find any member of our team if you need help.

Still wondering? Email beyondtheveil.atx@gmail.com.
